spanish: ¿Control ya no nos oye?
english: Can't Control hear us anymore?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Durante un rato no. Luego vuelven.
english: Not for a while. They'll be back.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Pues luego diles que me porto bien.
english: Then tell them later that I behaved.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿A ti te pagan por esto?
english: Do they pay you for this?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Poco. ¿Y tú pagaste por venir?
english: Not much. And you paid to come?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Muchísimo.
english: A fortune.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Puedo pulsar algo? Uno pequeño.
english: Can I press something? A small one.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Ese de ahí. No hace nada.
english: That one there. It does nothing.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Qué emoción!
english: How exciting!

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Aquí dentro hace mucho calor!
english: It's really hot in here!

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Aguanta. Ya casi pasa.
english: Hold on. It's almost over.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Por qué damos vueltas? ¿Es parte del viaje?
english: Why are we spinning? Is this part of the trip?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: No. Pero lo estoy arreglando.
english: No. But I'm fixing it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No puedo levantar los brazos.
english: I can't lift my arms.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Ni lo intentes. Ya bajará.
english: Don't even try. It'll ease off.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Qué ha sido ese golpe?
english: What was that bang?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Nada grave. Siéntate.
english: Nothing serious. Sit down.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ya lo estoy. Más que nunca.
english: I am. More than ever.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Esto pasa en todos los viajes?
english: Does this happen on every trip?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: En los buenos, sí.
english: On the good ones, yes.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Quiero bajarme. ¿Dónde está la parada?
english: I want to get off. Where's the stop?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: No hay paradas. Respira.
english: There are no stops. Breathe.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Primera vez en un cohete?
english: First time on a rocket?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Primera vez fuera de casa.
english: First time out of the house.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ese panel no se toca, por favor.
english: Please don't touch that panel.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: No lo toco. Solo lo miro de cerca.
english: I'm not touching it. Just looking closely.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Más de lejos.
english: From farther away.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Mira por la ventana. ¿Qué te parece?
english: Look out the window. What do you think?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Que valía lo que pagué.
english: That it was worth the money.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Estás bien? Tienes mala cara.
english: Are you okay? You don't look well.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Floto y tengo mala cara. Todo nuevo para mí.
english: I'm floating and I look bad. All new to me.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ahí tienes una bolsa.
english: There's a bag right there.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Si necesitas algo, pregunta.
english: If you need anything, ask.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Hay películas?
english: Are there any movies?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Hay ventana.
english: There's a window.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Cuando empiece a temblar, no grites.
english: When it starts shaking, don't scream.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Y si grito un poquito?
english: And if I scream a little?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Un poquito vale.
english: A little is fine.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Deja de girar el asiento.
english: Stop spinning the seat.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: El asiento no gira. Giro yo.
english: The seat isn't spinning. I am.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Te doy la bienvenida a otro mundo.
english: Welcome to another world.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Huele igual que el de antes.
english: It smells just like the old one.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ponte el cinturón para dormir.
english: Strap in when you sleep.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Para no caerme?
english: So I don't fall?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Para no despertar flotando en la cocina.
english: So you don't wake up floating in the galley.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Tu comida está en el cajón azul.
english: Your food is in the blue drawer.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Esto es comida? Pensaba que era pasta de dientes.
english: This is food? I thought it was toothpaste.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Respira despacio. El mareo se pasa.
english: Breathe slowly. The sickness passes.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Cuándo?
english: When?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Más o menos cuando aterricemos.
english: Roughly when we land.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No salgas. Lo digo en serio.
english: Don't go outside. I mean it.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Ni siquiera sé abrir la puerta.
english: I don't even know how to open the door.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Mejor así.
english: Better that way.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Qué vas a contar cuando vuelvas?
english: What will you tell everyone when you get back?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Que pilotaba yo.
english: That I was flying it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Claro que sí.
english: Of course you were.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ahora se calienta todo. Con calma.
english: Now everything heats up. Stay calm.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Estoy en calma. Por fuera.
english: I'm calm. On the outside.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Las manos en las rodillas, por favor.
english: Hands on your knees, please.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿En las mías o en las tuyas?
english: Mine or yours?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ese ruido es el ventilador. No pasa nada.
english: That noise is the fan. Nothing's wrong.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Llevo una hora con miedo a un ventilador.
english: I've been scared of a fan for an hour.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Esto es fuerte, pero está previsto.
english: This is rough, but it's planned.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Previsto por quién?
english: Planned by whom?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Por gente muy lista. Creo.
english: By very smart people. I think.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Estamos girando. Cierra los ojos.
english: We're spinning. Close your eyes.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Con los ojos cerrados giro más.
english: With my eyes closed I spin more.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Vas a notar mucho peso. Es normal.
english: You'll feel very heavy. That's normal.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Me siento como un saco de patatas.
english: I feel like a sack of potatoes.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Estás bien? Eso ha sido un golpe.
english: Are you okay? That was a bump.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Me he mordido la lengua. Y el bocadillo.
english: I bit my tongue. And my sandwich.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Mírame a mí, no a la ventana.
english: Look at me, not at the window.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Tu cara tampoco me tranquiliza.
english: Your face doesn't calm me down either.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Suelta esa palanca. Despacio.
english: Let go of that lever. Slowly.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Esta? Ya está. ¿Qué hacía?
english: This one? Done. What did it do?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Mejor no lo sepas.
english: Better you don't know.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Tú también compraste el paquete completo?
english: Did you buy the full package too?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: No. El básico. Sin ventana.
english: No. The basic one. No window.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Te dejo mirar por la mía.
english: You can look through mine.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Eso de ahí es una estrella o un botón?
english: Is that a star or a button?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Un botón. Las estrellas están fuera.
english: A button. The stars are outside.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Mira, floto boca abajo.
english: Look, I'm floating upside down.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Aquí no hay abajo. Lo ha dicho la tripulación.
english: There's no down up here. The crew said so.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Pues entonces floto boca arriba.
english: Then I'm floating right side up.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Crees que nos dejarán conducir un poco?
english: Do you think they'll let us drive a bit?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Yo ya pregunté. Se rieron mucho.
english: I already asked. They laughed a lot.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Me he comido tu postre.
english: I ate your dessert.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Eso era mi cena.
english: That was my dinner.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Pues estaba buenísimo.
english: Well, it was delicious.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Cuántas fotos llevas?
english: How many photos have you taken?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Cuatrocientas. Casi todas de la ventana.
english: Four hundred. Almost all of the window.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Yo tengo cuatrocientas tuyas mirando la ventana.
english: I have four hundred of you looking at the window.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Ya hemos llegado?
english: Are we there?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Creo que sí. Ya no se mueve nada.
english: I think so. Nothing's moving anymore.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Qué pena. Ahora que me gustaba.
english: Shame. Just when I liked it.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Aquí no hay nada.
english: There's nothing here.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Por eso es tan caro.
english: That's why it's so expensive.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Entiendes algo de lo que dicen por la radio?
english: Do you understand anything they say on the radio?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Solo la palabra recibido. La dicen mucho.
english: Just the word copy. They say it a lot.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Si me desmayo, despiértame para la foto.
english: If I faint, wake me up for the photo.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Si me desmayo yo, haz la foto igual.
english: If I faint, take the photo anyway.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: El folleto decía que había vistas.
english: The brochure said there'd be a view.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Hay vistas.
english: There is a view.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Decía vistas con aperitivo.
english: It said a view with snacks.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Tú te mareas?
english: Do you get sick?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Solo cuando me miras así.
english: Only when you look at me like that.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Voy a escribir una reseña.
english: I'm going to write a review.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¿Cuántas estrellas?
english: How many stars?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Todas las que veo. Son muchas.
english: All the ones I can see. That's a lot.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Sabes qué hace la tripulación todo el día?
english: Do you know what the crew does all day?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Mirar números y suspirar.
english: Look at numbers and sigh.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Tú también lo ves todo naranja?
english: Do you see everything orange too?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Yo veo mi vida entera.
english: I see my whole life.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Nos dejarán quedarnos una noche más?
english: Will they let us stay one more night?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Pregunta tú. Yo ya pregunté lo de conducir.
english: You ask. I already asked about driving.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Es normal este calor?
english: Is this heat normal?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: La tripulación no grita. Será normal.
english: The crew isn't screaming. Must be normal.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Estamos girando!
english: We're spinning!

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: ¡Ya lo sé! ¡Mi bocadillo también!
english: I know! So is my sandwich!

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Me pesan hasta las orejas.
english: Even my ears feel heavy.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Las mías se han hundido en el asiento.
english: Mine sank into the seat.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Qué ha sido eso?
english: What was that?

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: No lo sé. Yo no he tocado nada. Esta vez.
english: I don't know. I didn't touch anything. This time.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Dame la mano.
english: Hold my hand.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Ya te la doy. La que tiembla es la mía.
english: I am. The shaking one is mine.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Si salimos de esta, pido que me devuelvan el dinero.
english: If we get out of this, I want a refund.

speaker: kerbal_b
spanish: Yo pido el doble.
english: I want double.
